Repository notes & sources
HALLOWEEN EDITION · repository review: October 31, 2026
vLLM release page currently lists v0.32.0. llm-d Inference Scheduler is now llm-d Router. This is a tuning map, not a compatibility guarantee. Existing flow-control labels and optimization classifications are conceptual; reload behavior depends on the component and deployment.
Updated: structured speculative/compilation configuration, async scheduling, explicit KV memory and dtype, KV events, API workers. Removed legacy standalone speculative, tokenizer-pool, multi-step and guided-decoding flags.
Current directions: low-precision KV (hardware dependent), Model Runner V2, session-aware routing, tiered KV offload, P/D specialization, experimental predicted-latency scheduling. Cascade attention and AsyncTP compilation passes were removed in v0.32.0.
